_note: Team identity over time. OpenDota returns whatever a team_id is called NOW, which silently rewrites history — team 39 comes back as 'Shopify Rebellion' for a 2018 event. `names` records what a team was called AS OF a given event, and is the only thing the UI may display. `opendota_current_name` is stored so a future ingest can detect drift, never for display.

_source_types.owner-confirmation: Confirmed directly by the project owner, who watched these events live. A first-class source for this project.

teams.note: Team names must reflect what the team was called at the event. Liquipedia's TI8 page agrees: PSG.LGD.
OpenDota returns an empty string for this team_id.
